audit.why: Riot's kit: Q is Arcanopulse (750), W is Eye of Destruction (1000, slow only), E is Shocking Orb (1050, the stun). Two fabricated facts in one sentence.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0].text with the real names and ranges; fixed wants.foe[1] the same way.

audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t and late.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Check it before every step-up. - E-Q stun package is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (E): 13s at rank 1, 11s maxed, and his only stun — dodge it and the artillery never converts into a kill. - Eye of Destruction (W) is 14s and slows only. - Bank your 8s Sear: a stun cancels his 130s channelled R outright.

edits.before: His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame lands after a delay at 900 — put it where he must stand to charge Arcanopulse, not where he stands.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Conflagration (E) is point-and-click inside 625 and ablazes on cast — it is the only thing that turns your 1050-range Sear into a stun.

edits.before: Xerath burns Shocking Orb (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Xerath whiffs Shocking Orb and you get 13 seconds at rank 1 to walk him down.

edits.before: That is Xerath’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Unablazed, Sear (Q) is 70 mana and 8s spent for no stun and no answer to him.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Xerath at full health behind a minion wall costs you 220 mana for chip — hold the rotation for the window where Shocking Orb is on cooldown.

edits.before: Track Xerath’s Shocking Orb (Stun): His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Shocking Orb (E), 13s at rank 1 — his only stun. And Rite of the Arcane is a channel: an ablaze Sear stun cancels the whole barrage.

edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Xerath wins by holding you at 1050 range with Shocking Orb, then closing games from 5000 units away with Rite of the Arcane.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry by punishing the immobile artillerist — he has no dash, so E-Q always lands and Pyroclasm bounces where he has to stand.

edits.before: If Xerath gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Shocking Orb (Stun) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with W-E clears and stay relevant through stun-burn peel.
edits.after: If Xerath gets a kill, farm behind the minion wall — Arcanopulse is a line beam the wave absorbs, and Shocking Orb on 13s is the only cast that starts a kill on you. Stay relevant as stun-burn peel.

edits.before: Xerath's Arcane Barrage (Q) and Eye of Destruction (E) stun outrange Pillar of Flame by a wide margin, letting him poke you down risk-free through this whole phase.
edits.after: Arcanopulse (Q), Eye of Destruction (W) at 1000 and Shocking Orb (E) at 1050 all outreach Pillar of Flame's 900, so he pokes from outside your W and only Sear answers.

edits.before: Level 3: added Pillar of Flame doesn't come close to matching his Q/E range, so Xerath keeps winning every exchange.
edits.after: Level 3: Pillar of Flame reaches 900 against Shocking Orb's 1050, so he pokes from outside it and wins the exchanges.

edits.before: In the late game your combo damage and Pyroclasm zoning give you real threat in teamfights, especially once you can force him to commit Rite of the Arcane early or bait out Shocking Orb. You're still not outranging his poke, but your burst window and all-in potential make you the stronger threat once fights get close-range.
edits.after: In the late game your combo damage and Pyroclasm zoning give you real threat in teamfights, and Rite of the Arcane is a channel — an ablaze Sear stun ends it mid-barrage. You're still not outranging his poke, but your burst window and all-in potential make you the stronger threat once fights get close-range.

edits.before: Use minions to block his skillshots and avoid unnecessary trades
edits.after: Stand behind minions — Arcanopulse is a line beam the wave absorbs

edits.before: Land Eye of Destruction stuns to set up followup burst or jungler ganks
edits.after: Land Shocking Orb (E) stuns to set up followup burst or jungler ganks
